title: Crows Remember Your Face and Hold Grudges for 17 Years

scenes.text: Crows remember your face. And they can hold a grudge for seventeen years.
In two thousand six, a University of Washington scientist put on a scary mask, trapped seven crows, and let them go.
For years afterwards, anyone wearing that mask on campus got mobbed and scolded by crows. A different mask? Nothing.
On one walk, forty-seven out of fifty-three crows screamed at the mask. Most of them had never been trapped at all.
The birds that were caught warned the others, and even taught their chicks. The scolding only faded after seventeen years.
So be nice to the crows on your street. They're taking notes. Have you ever been dive-bombed by one?

description:
Crows remember human faces, and they can hold a grudge for up to 17 years.
In 2006, a University of Washington scientist trapped seven crows while wearing a mask. For years, anyone wearing that mask on campus was mobbed by crows, including birds that had never been trapped and chicks born later.
The scolding only faded after 17 years.
Have you ever been dive-bombed by a crow?
